name: com.nesimplicity/real-estate
description: Read-only SimpliCity Real Estate tools: Wade Bartels info, area names, home search and contact links

tools.name: get_public_agent_info
tools.description: Public facts about Wade Bartels and SimpliCity Real Estate: service areas, specializations, license verification link, and the single published business phone number.

tools.name: get_booking_link
tools.description: Returns Wade's contact page URL where a user can request a planning conversation. Does not submit a lead from this gateway.

tools.name: search_listings
tools.description: Does not return MLS listing rows. Returns idx_search_url on nesimplicity.com/homes/search with the same query parameters as the IDX app (q, price, minPrice, beds), plus a short note.

tools.name: get_area_info
tools.description: Town and neighborhood names with county or city. Place names only, not a ranking.

query.description: Town or neighborhood name, e.g. Waverly or Near South
